dialogues.speaker: Ipacura
dialogues.text: #{M#Mister}{F#Missy}, you're crazy strong! You're the strongest warrior I've ever met!

dialogues.speaker: Ipacura
dialogues.text: Can I be as strong as you one day? I want to become a true champion of the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If you work hard, I'm sure you can.

dialogues.speaker: Ipacura
dialogues.text: I'll work hard, just you wait!
